name: Halwani Bros. Co. Ltd.
summary: Halwani Bros. Co. Ltd. engages in the manufacturing, packaging, wholesale, and retail trade of food products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Arab Republic of Egypt, and internationally. It offers halawa, maamoul, tahina, breaded chicken, meat, dairy, cheese, jams, juices, and olives and red pepper with oil. The company also provides sterile swabs; tissue boxes; tissue sachets; and brown and white sugar sachets, etc. Additionally, it offers catering services. The company was founded in 1830 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Halwani Bros. Co. Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Aseer Al-Arabia for Industrial Investment.
